import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Complex Polynomial LinearMap FiniteDimensional Module Module.End
open scoped BigOperators

theorem intersection_is_greatest_invariant_submodule {F V ι : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Field F] [Module F V]
  (u : ι → Submodule F V) (f : V →ₗ[F] V)
  (hpres : ∀ i : ι, ∀ x : V, x ∈ u i → f x ∈ u i) :
  ∃ U : Submodule F V,
    (⋂ i : ι, (u i).carrier) = (↑U : Set V) ∧
    (∀ x : V, x ∈ U → f x ∈ U) ∧
    (∀ T : Submodule F V,
      (∀ x : V, x ∈ T → f x ∈ T) →
      (∀ i : ι, T ≤ u i) →
      T ≤ U ∧ ∀ x : V, x ∈ T → f x ∈ T) := by
  use ⨅ i, u i
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · ext x
    simp [Submodule.mem_iInf]
  · intro x hx
    rw [Submodule.mem_iInf] at hx ⊢
    exact fun i => hpres i x (hx i)
  · intro T hT hle
    exact ⟨le_iInf hle, hT⟩

theorem intersection_is_greatest_invariant_submodule {F V ι : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Field F] [Module F V]
  (u : ι → Submodule F V) (f : V →ₗ[F] V)
  (hpres : ∀ i : ι, ∀ x : V, x ∈ u i → f x ∈ u i) :
  ∃ U : Submodule F V,
    (⋂ i : ι, (u i).carrier) = (↑U : Set V) ∧
    (∀ x : V, x ∈ U → f x ∈ U) ∧
    (∀ T : Submodule F V,
      (∀ x : V, x ∈ T → f x ∈ T) →
      (∀ i : ι, T ≤ u i) →
      T ≤ U ∧ ∀ x : V, x ∈ T → f x ∈ T) := by
  let U := ⨅ i, u i
  have hU_eq : (U : Set V) = ⋂ i : ι, (u i : Set V) := by
    ext x
    simp [U, Submodule.mem_iInf]
  have hU_inv : ∀ x : V, x ∈ U → f x ∈ U := by
    intro x hx
    rw [Submodule.mem_iInf] at hx ⊢
    intro i
    exact hpres i x (hx i)
  refine ⟨U, ?_, hU_inv, ?_⟩
  · exact hU_eq.symm
  · intro T hT_inv hT_le
    have hT_le_U : T ≤ U := by
      intro x hx
      rw [Submodule.mem_iInf]
      intro i
      exact hT_le i hx
    exact And.intro hT_le_U hT_inv
